ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE - Paths
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses and stored in suspicious locations using Wget.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wget\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX("://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-O\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output\\-document.*")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Help\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*"))))
